properties.site-address: Blackbird Leys District Centre, Blackbird Leys Road, Oxford, (Blackbird Leys Central Area)
properties.notes: Application 18/03405/FUL for 21 residential units. The site is allocated for mixed use development (including housing) in the Sites and Housing Plan adopted in February 2013. The allocation also remains in the emerging Local Plan 2036, which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings). Blackbird Leys is one of five priority regeneration areas identified in the Oxford Core Strategy 2026.
